name: Khurja
sourceReview: Official Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh, Board of Revenue and Bhunaksha services evidence state/tehsil revenue cadastral-map custody. Bhunaksha metadata resolved Bulandshahar district 142 and Khurja tehsil 00751, but no anonymous safe parcel feature response was verified.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed with official Bhulekh, Board of Revenue, Bhunaksha and Khurja digitization-dashboard results.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Hindi; official dashboard and revenue-service results found.
queryReview.geometry: No machine-readable parcel geometry returned; no GeoJSON retained.

requestOutcomes: Official HTML and current Bhunaksha JavaScript returned HTTP 200. Anonymous metadata calls returned district, tehsil, village selectors and GIS code 0914200751. Map-info requests returned HTTP 200 with zero extents and no attribution or parcel geometry. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: Tehsil map-service custody is not proof of a citywide open parcel layer.
No native parcel identity, CRS, or full polygon was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was written.
The zero map extent and lack of an exact-point parcel response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, legal-description, or value fields were requested or retained.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: Official sources evidence a local/tehsil revenue map custodian and digitization metadata, but not anonymous parcel API access, native schema/CRS, city coverage, or completeness. No claim is made about parcel absence, ownership, title, tax records, or completeness of Uttar Pradesh systems.
